name: Admin Proposal → Platform Handoff
description: After a proposal is accepted, admin clicks 'Lanzar a plataforma' from the actions modal — POST /api/proposals/:id/launch-to-platform/ — which creates a PlatformProject linked to the proposal and sends the client a platform invitation email with an OTP. Admin sees a 'Ver en plataforma' action in the proposal actions panel. Client then starts the platform onboarding flow (platform-login → platform-verify-onboarding → platform-complete-profile).
